A line-break-only emphasis inside a table cell still separates the words on either side

```elixir title="Elixir"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><strong>Alpha</strong><em><br></em>Beta</td></tr></table>")
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
